1. Upload

Start here with any logo image. You'll land in Logo Creation next to crop out an icon and clean it up — nothing leaves your browser at any point.

Drop your logo here, or click to browse

PNG, JPG, or SVG · or just paste an image with Ctrl+V / Cmd+V

Choose a logo to start

Pick the logo you want icons from. Zoom out to fit a wide or tall logo, or zoom in on just the symbol.

2. Asset Creation

The quick, no-layers path to your initial core assets: frame the icon (zoom out to fit any logo shape) and, optionally, strip a solid background color. Skip this if you already extracted an icon in Logo Creation and sent it to Export directly.

Frame your icon

Drag to move the logo. Zoom out to fit a wide or tall logo inside the square; the extra space stays transparent.

—

Remove background

Tolerance30

Best for logos on a flat, solid-color background. Click "Pick color" then click the background in the image to target it.

No icon assets yet

Make them in Asset Creator, or select a layer in Logo Creator and choose "Use this layer as my core asset".

4. Export

The final step. Your initial core assets — favicon, apple touch icon, social square, and color palette, generated from whichever image reached here (via Asset Creation, or "Use this layer as my core asset" in Logo Creation). Download individually, or grab everything as one zip, including any logo variations you've saved in Logo Creation.

3. Logo Creation

Where you land right after uploading. Crop, trim, or split your logo to isolate a clean icon (freeform/square/circle crop, trim-to-content, background removal), then either send it straight to Export as your core asset, or build logo variations — horizontal, vertical, white/recolored, fully custom — and save each as a named variant for your final zip.

Canvas × px
Quick arrange:

Repositions the mark and text layers as a starting point — still freely draggable after.

Start with your logo or a wordmark.

100%

Drag a layer to move it. Drag the corner dot to resize an image layer. Click empty canvas to deselect. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y to undo/redo. Arrow keys nudge the selected layer; Delete removes it; Ctrl+scroll zooms.
